scope: Static native formulas and primary asset reference chains for TIME initial data, Catap2 charged extension, Hadiya timer extension, and the selected Fever common branch. No implementation or tests changed; no client execution.

tool.writePolicy: Only this evidence JSON was written; bytecode writes disabled.

evidenceBoundary: All equations refer to the selected ordinary native branch and retained serialized configuration; runtime XLua overrides were not verified.

SP reduction timing depends on the actual Skill subclass. Catap2 S1 is CastSkillWithCost, S2 is RetriggerableCastSkillWithCost, as resolved afresh from the current MonoScript bundle; do not substitute the differently ordered CastSkill base DoCast.

Catap2 extension numerator D is the trigger Blackboard duration; the timer operation adds delta = abs(D*r*L) to the current target period P. Keep P + abs(D*r*L) as the general observed formula; the usual simplification D*(1+r*L) requires establishing P=D and nonnegative D and r for the chosen content path.
The retained ordinary ActiveBuffAbility initial maximum and explicit extension operations do not establish a global four-part Attribute formula for TIME.
Fever functions are retained as a selected configured branch; no claim that every Fever content implements pausing by one universal arithmetic rule is made.
Unity object IDs and PPtr m_PathID are decimal strings to avoid loss of 64-bit identity.

catap2.firstPayment: 72943 calls BasicSkill.ReduceSp(data.spCost) at 0x18096480b before calling ability.CastDirectly at 0x180964889; 73154 delegates to 72943.
catap2.samplePoint: BuffToOwner configured ON_CAST_START=2 installs catap2_s1/s2[trigger] on BeginAttack; template event0 samples the current SP after the explicit first-cost reduction in the selected normal path.

symbols.V: SP sampled by the trigger after first payment
symbols.C: current main SkillData.spCost sampled by AssignCharacterSkillSpCostToBB
symbols.r: extend_duration_ratio_each read from the talent Buff Blackboard

catap2.interpretation: The +1 accounts for the first charge already paid. Remaining SP is sampled then cleared explicitly; this is one content event sequence, not a persistent arbitrary duration contribution reducer.
catap2.reset: Template event2 checks that the Skill no longer affects, restores original cooldown via UpdateAbilityCoolDown, then finishes its trigger Buff.

initialPeriodSource.categoryRule: Only children for which (category & 4) != 0 participate; Ability.Category.ACTIVE is encoded as compressed signed byte 08 -> value 4.
initialPeriodSource.formulaWhenFalse: cachedCooldown = sum(child.cooldown for ACTIVE children), starting from FP zero.
initialPeriodSource.formulaWhenTrue: cachedCooldown = max(0, child.cooldown for ACTIVE children).
initialPeriodSource.catap2Configuration: Both actual S1Ability and S2Ability root components set _useLongestAbilityCooldown=0 and _timeMode=1.
initialPeriodSource.flow: DoSetData sets child data and calls _UpdateCooldownFromSubAbilities at 0x180efd57e; get_cooldown returns cached m_cooldown for the nonzero _timeMode branch.
initialPeriodSource.limitation: This establishes the configured initial period source. It does not identify every participating child duration with the trigger Blackboard duration or assert that later current timer period P equals that Blackboard value.

hadiya.template: hadiya_s_2[extand_time] event0 invokes ExtendAbilityCooldown(S2Ability, Blackboard.duration, keepPassedTime=true); event1 restores original cooldown.
formula: For a valid running timer: R_new = max(0, R + delta)
hadiya.scope: No current numerical claim of 15 seconds is inferred from this generic template; delta is supplied by the content Blackboard.

ordinaryInitialDuration.rule: When enabled, initialize m_lifeTime from Blackboard.duration; combine finite attached-Buff FetchDuration values by maximum. A non-ignored infinite Buff selects the configured infinite sentinel.
ordinaryInitialDuration.scope: Ability-specific data initialization; not a generic sum/multiply contribution formula.

feverSelectedBranch.rule: With _updateAbilityCooldown enabled, OnAfterJoinFever reads current Ability.cooldown, adds feverTime, and calls UpdateCooldown with waitFirst=false, keepPassedTime=true.
feverSelectedBranch.exit: Selected OnBeforeLeaveFever branch can interrupt/switch out and, when configured, restore SkillData.duration with a reset; complete loaded Fever-content policy was not verified.
